title: Apparitions of Knock
html_source:
In 1879, at dusk in August, a group of 15 parishioners reported seeing white images of the Virgin Mary, St. Joseph, the Lamb of God on an altar, a mitred figure generally labelled as St. John the Baptist, and angels on the back wall of the Parish Church at Knock. The images caught the attention of newspapers in Ireland and abroad.
